div.p: A required child element of agent, formAvailable, function, place, subject, and relation that indicates the name of the related entity.
agent, formAvailable, function, place, subject, relation
Use label to indicate the name of the related entity, either in the generic relation element or in one of the specific entity elements.

list.item: In agent, this can be the name of the agent responsible for the creation, modification, or deletion of an EAD instance, as captured in maintenanceEvent, or the name of the agent who has created, managed, used, or is mentioned in the archival materials.
In formAvailable, this may e.g. be the file name of a digitised version of a record resource.
In function, this may be the name of the function or subfunction that resulted in the creation of the materials being described.
In place, this can be the name of the place where a person was born or an organization was established, but also the location where the archival material being described are held.
In subject, this may be a term for the genre or type of record or theme represented in the materials being described.

div.p: It is recommended to use authorized vocabularies in cases where the element is valorized with a well-known corporation (i.e. "Library of Congress").

Use valueURI to provide the sequence of characters (e.g., URI) that uniquely identifies the entity in a controlled vocabulary, taxonomy, ontology, or other knowledge organization system. Use vocabularySource to identify the source where valueURI comes from, and vocabularySourceURI to point univocally to the organization system used.
Use this element in combination with agentType and role to encode also the agent’s type and role. I.e.: label: "John Bianchi",agentType: "person", role: "author" (in findAidDesc).
